d:
Why does Assam flood every single year? And why are floods now affecting places like Gujarat that were once considered relatively safe?
In this video, Abhi and Niyu uncover the real reasons behind India's growing flood crisis. From the geography of the Brahmaputra, climate change, aging embankments, illegal mining, and poor urban planning to the rise of extreme rainfall events, we explain why floods are becoming more frequent, more unpredictable, and more destructive across the country.
